title: Tier B/C empirical retests on clean baseline (2026-04-04)

retests.name: ALL-ON (pKa XGB + BZ Kp + Expanded CLint)
retests.notes: Less bad than contaminated, but outside predicted range. Sum of component deltas.

retests.name: CLint 3-class classification
retests.notes: Was improvement under contam; becomes noise under clean. Prediction of amplification WRONG.

retests.name: CLint descriptor upgrade (top-300 + Optuna)
retests.notes: CV R² +0.120 but engine holdout AAFE WORSENED (3.421→3.582). CV/holdout gap.

retests.name: k-NN read-across as 4th track
retests.notes: In-sample grid: -0.047 (seemed win). LOOCV: +0.163 (actual fail). k-NN as 4th track does NOT help under proper CV.

summary.robust_conclusion: All 4 empirically retested Tier B/C experiments FAIL under proper LOOCV on clean baseline. Predicted 'amplified improvements' did not materialize. #17 classifier's contaminated improvement was purely memorization artifact. #24 k-NN 4-track grid optimization was overfit; LOOCV reveals worse-than-baseline. The 2 confirmed reversals (#8 pKa, #10 pKa+BZ) remain the only Tier A wins.
